verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a state tax authority with a filing/payment portal and open-data datasets. It is not a platform that hosts user-built automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation-definition capability. The closest item, post-dating a Webfile payment, is a one-off payment setting, not a managed automation.
